result.title: Structural Conditional Independence Test via Neural Quantile Resolution
result.comment: Accepted at IEEE ICDM 2026. Code: https://github.com/khoangdadk/qrcit
result.summary: Conditional independence testing is difficult when dependence is weak, localized, or expressed through distributional changes rather than a global mean shift. Existing tests usually return a scalar statistic or p-value, which summarizes evidence against independence but does not describe where the conditional law changes. We propose QRCIT, a quantile-resolution conditional independence test that compares P(X|Z) and P(X|Y,Z) through a quantile deformation learned by a shared model. A lightweight residual quantile-flow model first learns the baseline conditional quantile law and then learns the additional deformation induced by Y, yielding a global predictive-gain statistic with conditional-randomization calibration and an inspectable deformation field over context and quantile level. We also introduce the Structural Dependency Benchmark (SDB), which evaluates dependence structures motivated by real applications, such as context-local, tail-only, sign-reversing, moving-ridge, and mean-neutral patterns. Across synthetic post-nonlinear (PNL) and SDB benchmarks, QRCIT improves detection of structured alternatives, with empirical Type-I behavior evaluated across settings. Higher quantile resolution improves merged-SDB power at moderate sample sizes, while diagnostics restricted to known affected regions improve detection of localized dependence. On Sachs, METABRIC breast cancer, and CCLE/PLX4720, QRCIT provides competitive real-data performance and interpretable deformation patterns. These results support quantile-resolved conditional-law deformation as a practical framework for testing and diagnosing structured conditional dependence.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 QRCIT：用共享的残差分位流模型先学习 P(X|Z) 的基线条件分位律，再学习 Y 引入的额外形变，从而比较 P(X|Z) 与 P(X|Y,Z)，给出全局预测增益统计量、条件随机化校准以及可检视的形变场；同时构建 SDB 基准，覆盖上下文局部、仅尾部、符号反转等结构化依赖。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“条件于上下文后是否仍依赖某变量”的检验与局部化形变诊断，可能可供核查 latent 状态中视觉证据的贡献是否集中在特定区域或分位段，以及弱依赖、局部依赖的检测思路；尚需确认能否迁移到高维内部表示。
